sinopsis.es: Con una interpretación bellamente contenida de Margaret Qualley (The Substance), este arrollador estudio de personaje romántico de la directora Rachel Morrison (The Fire Inside) es un testimonio estimulante sobre amar del todo, reparar el daño y seguir adelante.
sinopsis.en: Featuring a beautifully understated performance from Margaret Qualley (TIFF ’24’s The Substance), this sweeping romantic character study from director Rachel Morrison (TIFF ’24’s The Fire Inside) is an exhilarating testament to loving fully, making amends, and moving on.
